redessociais.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates a personal transformation seen as a positive evolution.

redessociais.significado: The Greatest Of All Time, used for legends of sports or music.
redessociais.exemplo_correto: With that many broken records, there's no doubt he's the GOAT of tennis.
exemplos_incorretos: I used the GOAT to tighten the bolt on my bike wheel.
He came dead last in every race this season, so everyone calls him the GOAT.
He won a single local tournament once, so he's officially the GOAT of the sport.
significados_incorretos: A wrench used to tighten bicycle parts.
The worst performer of all time in a given field.
Anyone who wins a single match or a small competition.
redessociais.impacto_motivo: Positive because it celebrates someone's exceptional achievement or performance.

redessociais.significado: All good, fine. It indicates that everything is calm and under control.
redessociais.exemplo_correto: No need to apologize for being late, it's all gucci, we'll wait for you to arrive.
exemplos_incorretos: For my birthday present, I saved up and bought an original gucci bag at the store.
The mechanic listened to the noise and said the engine's gucci belt snapped on the highway.
For Sunday family lunch, my aunt prepared a delicious traditional gucci with bolognese sauce.
significados_incorretos: A literal use referring to a luxury brand accessory.
A rubber part of a car engine.
A type of pasta cooked with tomato sauce.
redessociais.impacto_motivo: Positive because it expresses calm and satisfaction with the current situation.

redessociais.significado: An expression of strong admiration for someone who is physically very attractive.
redessociais.exemplo_correto: When he took off his shirt during the beach game, the crowd could only let out a GYAT!
exemplos_incorretos: Arriving at the gym, I went straight to use the heavy GYAT weight-plate machine to work out my legs.
My car started leaking oil and stopped at the red light because the brake GYAT blew out.
At snack time, we chopped the fruit and made a cold smoothie with strawberry and gyat.
significados_incorretos: A complex weightlifting exercise machine.
A hydraulic part of automotive brake systems.
A tropical fruit with a sweet and citrusy flavor.
redessociais.impacto_motivo: Positive because it expresses strong admiration for someone's physical attractiveness.

redessociais.significado: To officially reveal, without any mystery, a new relationship or product on social media.
redessociais.exemplo_correto: They stopped posting just their held hands and did the hard launch by posting a photo of them kissing.
exemplos_incorretos: We watched on television as the incredible hard launch of the rocket happened at the space base.
I was almost winning the match, but my video game gave a hard launch error and froze the screen.
The captain revved the engines of the huge hard launch to reach the island before the storm.

A fast motorboat equipped with a powerful engine.
redessociais.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it just describes the act of officially revealing something, with no specific value judgment.

redessociais.significado: Something that causes disgust, a sudden loss of attraction or total disinterest in a person.
redessociais.exemplo_correto: He was gorgeous, but he was rude to the waitress, which gave me an instant ick.
exemplos_incorretos: Since I went out without a coat in yesterday's heavy rain, I ended up catching a terrible ick that left me bedridden.
I went to the pharmacy to buy a bottle of strong syrup because I have an ick in my throat that won't go away.
I took it to the repair shop and the technician charged me a lot, saying my brand-new phone's screen had an ick.
significados_incorretos: A bad cold, flu or sudden high fever.
A dry, allergic and irritating cough.
A dead pixel, scratch or physical defect on an LED screen.
redessociais.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes a feeling of disgust or sudden loss of interest in someone.

redessociais.significado: If You Know, You Know. Used for inside jokes or obscure references.
redessociais.exemplo_correto: I posted that photo at the corner bar with the caption: the night of 2019... IYKYK.
exemplos_incorretos: My accountant sent me the complicated IYKYK form to fill out before filing my taxes.

A thick adapter cable for video transmission.
